_note: Realized waiver-acquisition shelf, pooled [2023, 2024, 2025]. THE STATISTIC IS THE MEDIAN OF THE CELL MEDIANS over (season, position, week) cells passing MIN_N — NOT the pooled median of every acquisition's points, which gives different numbers (QB 23.38 / RB 7.80 / WR 11.30 / TE 11.75) and is not what draft/tools ships. Recorded because these values are hand-copied into draft-day tools and verifying a copy should take one step, not three guesses.

QB.caveat: THIN: 1 cell(s), 5 player-week(s). One cell is one week of one season — this is a reading, not a shelf.

TE.caveat: THIN: 1 cell(s), 6 player-week(s). One cell is one week of one season — this is a reading, not a shelf.
